events.text: Eastbank traveling library brings borrowed books to three community halls every fortnight. Working name: Book Van Wednesdays. The same rota and membership desk serve all three stops; the driver returns all crates to the same branch store. The first visit starts at 15:00.

evidence.quote: Working name: Book Van Wednesdays

events.text: Large-print welcome pack LP-3 is a reusable set of joining instructions for library branches and outreach visits. Printing and accessibility checks form their own production job. The traveling library will distribute copies, but does not own every branch's use of this pack.

gold.rationale: Reusable publication distinct from distribution service.

evidence.quote: Large-print welcome pack LP-3

events.text: Book Van Wednesdays visit log: twelve readers joined at Moss Hall and asked for larger text on forms. The log records this stop in the existing Eastbank traveling library rota, with twelve new registrations entered in the service register.

evidence.quote: existing Eastbank traveling library rota

events.text: Eastbank traveling library is now publicized as Books on Your Doorstep. This replaces the working name Book Van Wednesdays; the same three-hall service and membership desk continue. The first visit remains 15:00 despite the new title dropping the weekday reference.

gold.rationale: Rename without identity or schedule change.

evidence.quote: This replaces the working name Book Van Wednesdays

events.text: Distribution receipt: fifty LP-3 welcome packs were handed to the Eastbank traveling library coordinator. The pack production job records the supplied batch, and the outreach rota records stock received for visits. Unsold branch stock remains outside the outreach inventory.

libraries.description: One celestial target occurs in an observing session and an independent processing-method comparison.

events.text: Autumn sky observing night ON-12 introduces visitors to the Moon and double stars at the hill field. The public session begins at 19:30 if skies clear. Volunteers may capture a few lunar frames during setup. The same visitor booking covers the telescope demonstrations and star-guide talk.
